info.title: P0.4 identity and workspace backend
info.description: JSON-only backend protocol contracts. This does not implement a visible authentication screen or establish real-provider conformance. A configured OIDC adapter proves authentication; application PostgreSQL sessions and current scoped grants own authorization. Authentication is not organization membership, seller mandate or verification. No CORS credential access is enabled. All responses are no-store and contain a server-generated X-Request-ID; clients cannot supply trusted actor, role, permission, organization or owner context. Body keys are exact and case-sensitive, duplicate keys and trailing JSON are rejected. All requests remain subject to the configured outer body/time limits. Optional query parameters other than those documented are rejected by callback.

parameters.description: When supplied, must equal the issuer verified by the configured adapter.

get.description: Requires exactly one valid __Host-marketplace-login cookie. Only state, code and optional iss are accepted; duplicates, provider error responses and unknown query fields fail. Consumes the persisted browser-bound transaction before the bounded provider exchange; a failed exchange requires a new flow. On success sets a fresh __Host-marketplace-session browser-session cookie and clears the login binding cookie. A prior session is rotated only within the same internal user; switching accounts requires logout. A verified new identity receives no workspace, membership, permission, mandate or verification badge.

Actor, owner, role, organization and permission fields cannot grant authority and are rejected. Failed validation, denial or rollback does not extend session idle activity.

CookieSession.name: __Host-marketplace-session
CookieSession.description: Opaque 256-bit browser session, one canonical cookie only. Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax/Path=/ with no Domain. Hash-only persistence and authoritative database expiry/revocation. Bearer Authorization headers are not supported.

LoginBinding.name: __Host-marketplace-login
LoginBinding.description: Short-lived opaque browser binding for a persisted one-time OIDC transaction; not an application session.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exactly one header equal to the configured HTTPS application origin, including any explicit port. Missing, null, sibling or foreign origins are rejected.

CSRF.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRF.description: Exactly one session-bound proof returned by GET /api/v1/session or successful callback; compared in constant time. A proof without its authenticated session cookie grants nothing.

OpaqueToken.description: Canonical unpadded base64url encoding of 32 bytes; noncanonical encodings are rejected where used as credentials.

session_id.description: Non-secret internal session identifier, not the browser credential.

name.description: Nonempty Unicode name with no leading/trailing whitespace or control characters.
